description: Search the AI Incident Database. Combines free-text with date range filters. Returns incident IDs, titles, dates, and a short blurb.

query.description: Free-text. Every word must appear somewhere in the incident title or description, in any order — "facial recognition bias" finds records mentioning all three, not that exact phrase. Fewer words match more.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD lower bound on incident date

name: search_incidents

has_more.description: True if more incidents exist past this page. AIID exposes no total count, so this is the only way to distinguish "end of results" from an empty response.

offset.description: The offset this page started at, echoed back.

returned.description: How many incidents are in this page (<= the requested limit).

title: Search Incidents
